title: DIS dissector: Added support for Air appearance flags
description:
This commit allows to display the details of the Appearance flag for Air object. The property list comes from the SISO-REF-010-2022, Reference for Enumerations for Simulation Interoperability, Version 30 (dated 2022), page 684 and 685.

Along the way I found a few issues I would like to discuss with the community:

1- entityKind and entityDomain are static variables. They are set in a function named dissect_DIS_FIELDS_ENTITY_TYPE. The problem is this function is called twice, meaning the entityKind and entityDomain will keep the values set from the second call. The second call is to parse the "Alternative Entity Type" which is optional and call sometime be set to all zeros. When that happens, the subsequent parsing of the appearance flag will fails because the code doesn't know which object type we are working with.

2- The EntityStateUpdate PDU also relies on these to variables being set beforehand which is a major problem. The ESUPDU relies of the EntityID field to know which object is being updated. Based on that EntityID, the parser shall find the last received EntityStatePDU message, for that given EntityID, to find the object type. This requires far more advanced parsing capabilities and I will need some guidance to make that happen. The way the code is written right now, the apperance flag will be parsed based on the last EntityStatePDU that was selected before.

3 - The "Smoke Entity" apperance flag, for Land object, is being displayed as a single 2 bit value whereas the SISO-REF-010 defines it as two 1-bit values
